text_description: Full-length runway look combining a relaxed prep top with an exaggerated romantic skirt and dark grounded footwear. The model wears a short-sleeve brown polo-style knit or jersey top with a small collar, short button placket, and narrow light horizontal stripes; the top fits loosely through the torso and sits slightly bloused/asymmetrically over the waist. Below it is a highly layered, above-the-knee skirt with mismatched volumes: a large pale pink satin-like bow is tied at the front-left waist with long hanging tails, a cream floral jacquard or brocade-looking puffed panel flares prominently over the model’s right hip, and soft blush-pink underlayers form tiered, translucent-looking ruffles around the hem. The top and skirt create a narrow waist with a wide, sculptural lower silhouette, mixing casual shirting proportions with couture-like drape and volume. Styling includes layered necklaces/chokers at the neck and a small beige-gold embellished handbag carried high at the left side with a decorative strap/chain. The legs are bare, and the footwear is black and heavy-looking: pointed dark shoes or boots are paired with slouched black ankle/leg covers that bunch around the lower legs, adding a punkish contrast to the pale, feminine skirt layers. The overall palette is brown, cream, blush pink, and black, with a deliberately eclectic, deconstructed, romantic-preppy mood.
key_elements: large pale pink front waist bow with long tails
cream floral jacquard-looking puffed skirt panel
layered blush-pink ruffled mini skirt underlayers
black pointed footwear with slouched ankle/leg covers
uncertainty_notes: Exact fabric content is not visually confirmable.
Footwear construction is partly obscured by the slouched black covers.
Skirt fastening and full construction are not visible.
